questions.solution:
22400 mL ${H}_{2}$ at STP $= 1\text{mol}{\text{H}}_{2}$
So 450 ml ${H}_{2}$ at STP
$= \dfrac{450\text{mL}}{22400\text{mL}} \times 1\text{mol}{\text{H}}_{2}$
$= 0.02$ mol
Electrode reaction
$2{H}^{+} + \mathop{2{e}^{-}}_{2\text{F}} \to \mathop{{H}_{2}}_{1\text{mol}}$
The liberation of 1 mol ${H}_{2}$ requires $= 2 \times 96500\text{C}$
So the liberation of 0.02 mol ${H}_{2}$ requires $= 2 \times 96500 \times 0.02\text{C}$
$= 3860$ C
Time required to produce 0.02 mol ${H}_{2}$ , $t = \dfrac{Q}{i}$
$= \dfrac{3860}{2\text{A}} = 1930\text{sec}$
